title: Compliance Project Assistant & Long Term Internship
desc:
Step into the future of fintech with us!
We’re not just a company; we’re a dynamic team of innovators pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. We're on the lookout for passionate, forward-thinking
Compliance Project Assistant & Long Term Internship (Ödero)
to join us on this exciting journey!
🔍Who We Are
At Token Financial Technologies, we lead Turkey’s fintech revolution, empowering over 800,000 users and handling nearly 4 million transactions daily. Our flagship solutions, Ödero and TokenFlex, redefine payment systems and corporate benefits with cutting-edge technology. As part of Koç Holding and partnering with Beko, we’re a team of innovators dedicated to driving progress and making a real impact in the financial world.
✨ What You’ll Be Rocking
Support the Compliance Department in AML/CFT, KYC, sanctions, and other compliance processes.
Monitor MASAK, the Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye (CBRT), and relevant national and international regulations, as well as industry developments; contribute to research and information-sharing activities.
Support customer onboarding, Know Your Customer (KYC), and customer risk assessment processes.
Contribute to control, analysis, and reporting activities carried out as part of customer and transaction monitoring processes.
Assist in the preparation and follow-up of training and awareness initiatives aimed at preventing money laundering and terrorist financing.
Contribute to compliance checks and risk assessment activities related to business partners, suppliers, and other third parties.
Collaborate with the team on projects aimed at digitalizing, automating, and improving compliance processes.
Support the Compliance Department's periodic reporting, documentation, and follow-up activities.
🎯 The Perfect Fit
Currently a third- or fourth-year university student or a graduate, preferably in Economics, Business Administration, or related fields, Statistics, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering, or Industrial Engineering.
Available to participate in a long-term internship program.
Interested in financial technologies, payment services, AML/KYC, and compliance.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.
Strong research, analytical, and reporting skills.
Detail-oriented, with strong follow-up and documentation skills.
Effective communication skills and a team-oriented mindset.
Eager to learn, proactive, and willing to take responsibility.
Preferably proficient in English at a level sufficient to follow and understand English-language resources.
